<template>
  <view class="home-page">
    <view class="home-header">
      <view class="home-title-row">
        <view class="title">今日好物</view>
        <text class="home-subtitle">精选限时优惠</text>
      </view>
      <image class="home-banner" src="/assets/home/banner.png" mode="aspectFill" />
    </view>

    <view class="category-tabs">
      <view
        class="category-tab"
        wx:for="{{categories}}"
        wx:key="id"
        wx:class="{{ {active: item.id === activeCategory} }}"
        bindtap="switchCategory(item.id)"
      >
        <text>{{item.name}}</text>
      </view>
    </view>

    <view class="product-grid">
      <product-card
        wx:for="{{products}}"
        wx:key="id"
        product="{{item}}"
        bindselect="openProduct"
        bindaddcart="addToCart"
      />
    </view>

    <view wx:if="{{loading}}" class="loading-row">
      <text>商品加载中...</text>
    </view>
    <view wx:elif="{{!products.length}}" class="empty-state">
      <text>当前分类暂无商品</text>
    </view>
  </view>
</template>

<script>
import { createPage } from '@mpxjs/core'

createPage({
  data: {
    activeCategory: 'featured',
    categories: [
      { id: 'featured', name: '精选' },
      { id: 'fresh', name: '生鲜' },
      { id: 'home', name: '家居' },
      { id: 'digital', name: '数码' }
    ],
    products: [
      {
        id: 'sku-1001',
        title: '云南高山蓝莓 4 盒装',
        subtitle: '产地直发 · 当日采摘',
        cover: '/assets/products/blueberry.png',
        price: '39.90',
        originalPrice: '59.90',
        salesText: '已售 2.3 万件',
        tag: '限时直降'
      },
      {
        id: 'sku-1002',
        title: '便携式手冲咖啡套装',
        subtitle: '办公室也能喝现磨',
        cover: '/assets/products/coffee.png',
        price: '129.00',
        originalPrice: '169.00',
        salesText: '已售 8600 件',
        tag: '新品'
      }
    ],
    loading: false
  },
  methods: {
    switchCategory (categoryId) {
      if (categoryId === this.activeCategory) return
      this.activeCategory = categoryId
      this.fetchProducts()
    },
    fetchProducts () {
      this.loading = true
      wx.request({
        url: '/api/mall/products',
        data: { category: this.activeCategory },
        success: ({ data }) => {
          this.products = data.list
        },
        complete: () => {
          this.loading = false
        }
      })
    },
    openProduct ({ detail }) {
      wx.navigateTo({
        url: `/packageProduct/pages/detail/index?id=${detail.productId}`
      })
    },
    addToCart ({ detail }) {
      wx.request({
        url: '/api/cart/items',
        method: 'POST',
        data: { productId: detail.productId, count: 1 },
        success: () => {
          wx.showToast({ title: '已加入购物车', icon: 'success' })
        }
      })
    }
  }
})
</script>

item.text: 问题集中在三处：价格区域混用 `px/rpx` 且小字号容易触发 WebView 文本自动放大；首页与卡片都使用通用 `.title`，首页还有裸 `image` 选择器；卡片关键盒子未显式统一盒模型。接下来会用组件前缀类名、局部作用域和一致的 `rpx` 尺寸修复，同时原样保留脚本、事件和 JSON 配置。
两份完整文件已写入。现在只做最终校验：确认当前目录除 `outputs/` 外没有改动、交互逻辑与配置未变化，并检查样式中不再存在混用的 `px` 或会跨组件命中的裸元素/通用标题选择器。
